scenarios.name: sacrificing-a-creature-deals-one
scenarios.why: The {1}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature ability sacrifices the Grizzly Bears as a cost and deals 1 damage to the chosen target (p1), so p1 drops to 19 and the Bears are in the graveyard.

scenarios.name: with-no-other-permanent-the-ability-is-not-offered
scenarios.why: The ability's additional cost sacrifices an artifact or creature, and with only the Munitions (an enchantment) on the battlefield the cost cannot be paid, so the activation is not offered.
